args.question: What is the cardholder statement about this transaction?

args.narrative: AVS matched (Y) and CVV matched (M) on this card-absent order of 183.21 USD. USPS delivered it on 2026-01-18. The card has three prior undisputed transactions with us (p1, p2, p3) and account activity on file, so the case is eligible for Compelling Evidence 3.0.

args.explanation: Visa 10.4 card-absent fraud chargeback for 183.21 USD; cardholder said they do not recognise the charge. The case file had AVS/CVV match, account activity, USPS delivery proof, and prior undisputed history listing three earlier transactions; it had no device/IP match document, one of the two required kinds. Represented with the AVS/CVV match, prior history, account activity, delivery proof, authorization and receipt. The case moved to pre-arbitration (25.00 USD fee), and the issuer then accepted, resolving it for the merchant. Remaining cost is the 15.00 chargeback and 25.00 pre-arbitration fees. No documents uploaded.
